scope: Binary-kernel KL concentration, known uniform 4D de Sitter, independent identical clouds, fixed M, h in [0,1/2]
primary_gate: At least twofold reduction in refined sufficient design cloud counts at each of h=0.1,0.25,0.5; exact integer ratios; unchanged >=95pct analytical fixed-budget coverage.
fresh_policy: Execute all declared cells only if the primary budget gate passes; no enlargement, refitting, post hoc domain changes, reseeding or optional stopping.
evidence: Mathematical development and off-grid/exact controls precede freeze; target budgets and fresh campaign follow public source freeze. Fresh group comparisons are descriptive, not an independent proof of coverage.
